assessment: The present work uses structural approaches to describe how an ATPase known as a 'clamp loader' opens a ring-shaped clamp protein and binds DNA to promote the deposition of the clamp around a nucleic acid duplex to support chromosomal replication. The paper is important in that it reports new findings on how different regions of the clamp loader bind to and open a clamp, and how the enzyme engages single-stranded and double-stranded regions of target DNAs. Different conformational states of the clamp loader and the clamp are observed, providing a molecular picture of several steps in the clamp loading cycle.
